summary: The PR addresses the issue of the autoreloader not tracking changes in manage.py by adding a special case for the __main__ module.

issues.description: The change introduces a special case for the __main__ module, which might be seen as a deviation from the usual handling of modules. However, given the specific nature of the __main__ module, this seems justified.
There is no update to the documentation or comments to explain the new handling of the __main__ module, which could make future maintenance harder.
